status: Generated base photographs; one image per shot. Screenshot compositing and text overlays not applied.

assets.title: The scan at the boom
assets.altText: A security officer at an estate boom gate scanning a QR code on a visitor's phone.
assets.screenshot: Security role, Gate register, after a successful scan
assets.overlayCopy: Scanned, checked, recorded. Thirty seconds.

assets.title: The guest with no smartphone
assets.altText: An older woman reading a code from a slip of paper to a security guard at a pedestrian gate.
assets.screenshot: Security role, Gate code field with a confirmed match
assets.overlayCopy: No smartphone? Still gets in.

assets.title: The card in their hand
assets.altText: Hands passing a South African identity card across a guard house counter beside a tablet.
assets.screenshot: Security role, Identity number search returning one match
assets.overlayCopy: Arrived with nothing? The card is enough.

assets.title: The cleaner who comes every weekday
assets.altText: A domestic worker greeting a security guard at a staff entrance early in the morning.
assets.screenshot: Security role, Regular passes with On site now populated
assets.overlayCopy: Every weekday, 06:30 to 15:00. Signed in, signed out, recorded.

assets.title: Who is inside right now
assets.altText: A security officer in a guard house glancing at a wall-mounted tablet at dusk, a closed paper logbook beside her.
assets.screenshot: Security role, On site now panel with two people inside
assets.overlayCopy: Two people on site. Both signed in by name.

assets.title: The record you keep today
assets.altText: A worn paper visitors book open on a guard house counter, filled in many different hands.
assets.screenshot: none
assets.overlayCopy: This is the record. Until something happens.

assets.title: Booking a guest from the couch
assets.altText: A young man booking a visitor on his phone in his apartment living room in the evening.
assets.screenshot: Resident role, Request a guest visit form
assets.overlayCopy: Book your guest in before they leave home.

assets.title: Confirmed with their own password
assets.altText: Close view of hands holding a phone, screen bright, in soft window light.
assets.screenshot: Resident role, password confirmation step
assets.overlayCopy: Your guest, in your name, with your password.

assets.title: The pass arrives before they do
assets.altText: A woman checking her phone in a parked car before driving to a visit.
assets.screenshot: The /pass/[token] guest pass page with QR and gate code
assets.overlayCopy: You are on the system. Before you travel.

assets.title: Reading the code to a guest
assets.altText: A woman on the phone in her kitchen reading a code from a second phone on the counter.
assets.screenshot: Resident role, the pass detail showing the gate code
assets.overlayCopy: The text never arrived. Read it to them.

assets.title: Reporting the leak
assets.altText: A woman crouched by a dripping bathroom tap holding her phone.
assets.screenshot: Resident role, Report an issue with urgency chosen
assets.overlayCopy: Logged, ranked, and on someone's screen.

assets.title: The water is off on Tuesday
assets.altText: A man filling water bottles at his kitchen sink with his phone propped nearby.
assets.screenshot: Resident role, Notice board with the water outage announcement
assets.overlayCopy: Told once. Reached everyone.

assets.title: Reception, mid-morning
assets.altText: A receptionist at an apartment building counter speaking with a resident collecting a parcel.
assets.screenshot: Reception role, Overview with the urgent announcement banner
assets.overlayCopy: Everything the building needs, on one screen.

assets.title: Move-in day at the desk
assets.altText: A couple with moving boxes at a reception counter while the receptionist enrols them.
assets.screenshot: Reception role, enrolment form with unit selected
assets.overlayCopy: Enrolled at the desk. Signed in before the kettle is unpacked.

assets.title: Issuing a contractor's pass
assets.altText: A painting contractor handing his identity card to an estate office administrator.
assets.screenshot: Reception role, Issue a regular pass form
assets.overlayCopy: Days, hours, an end date. Issued once.

assets.title: A building enrolled from one file
assets.altText: A letting agent sitting back with a coffee after finishing a bulk enrolment at her desk.
assets.screenshot: Manager role, People, import result showing residents enrolled
assets.overlayCopy: A hundred residents. One file. One pass of emails.

assets.title: Phoning the plumber
assets.altText: A property manager on the phone in his office with a laptop and keys on the desk.
assets.screenshot: Manager role, Maintenance queue with an urgent item
assets.overlayCopy: Most urgent first. The plumber is one screen away.

assets.title: Writing it once
assets.altText: Over the shoulder of a woman typing at a laptop beside a municipal water notice.
assets.screenshot: Manager role, Publish an announcement form
assets.overlayCopy: Say it once. Everyone has it.

assets.title: The month, reconciled
assets.altText: A property manager reconciling accounts at her desk with a laptop and calculator.
assets.screenshot: Manager role, Money screen for the month
assets.overlayCopy: Marked paid in one place. Counted in the other.

assets.title: Filed where it will be found
assets.altText: Hands placing a signed lease onto a scanner beside a laptop.
assets.screenshot: Manager role, Documents, a tenancy folder
assets.overlayCopy: It stays with the stay, not with the tenant.

assets.title: The link that starts it
assets.altText: A young woman sitting on the floor of a half-unpacked flat looking at her phone.
assets.screenshot: The /join page showing username and unit
assets.overlayCopy: Your own password. Not your manager's.

assets.title: Intake day
assets.altText: Students with suitcases being checked into a private student residence on intake day.
assets.screenshot: Reception role, People, after a bulk import
assets.overlayCopy: The fortnight your whole year turns on.

assets.title: Two of three beds
assets.altText: Two young women unpacking in a shared flat with a third empty bedroom behind them.
assets.screenshot: Manager role, Units register showing 2 of 3 occupants
assets.overlayCopy: Two of three. The third bed is still free.

assets.title: The call a parent does not have to make
assets.altText: A student walking into a well-lit controlled entrance of a residence at dusk.
assets.screenshot: none
assets.overlayCopy: She got in at 19:12. You could know that.

assets.title: Answering the trustees
assets.altText: A managing agent turning a tablet toward trustees at a body corporate meeting.
assets.screenshot: Manager role, Gate register filtered to a date
assets.overlayCopy: "Who was on the estate that Tuesday?" Ten seconds.

assets.title: The guard's shift, made simpler
assets.altText: Portrait of a security officer standing in the doorway of a guard house at the start of her shift.
assets.screenshot: none
assets.overlayCopy: The book was never the hard part. Finding it afterwards was.

assets.title: Ordinary evening
assets.altText: A South African residential complex at blue hour with lit windows and people walking a dog.
assets.screenshot: none
assets.overlayCopy: Know who is at your gate, and why.

assets.title: The landlord with one block
assets.altText: A landlord standing in the yard of his small block of flats with keys and a phone.
assets.screenshot: Manager role, Billing on the free tier
assets.overlayCopy: Five units. Ten residents. R0.

assets.title: What the guard never sees
assets.altText: A South African identity card lying face down on a wooden counter beside keys and a notebook.
assets.screenshot: none
assets.overlayCopy: The gate reads the card. The screen shows four characters.

assets.title: The doorway
assets.altText: An open forest green pedestrian gate leading into a sunlit planted courtyard.
assets.screenshot: none
assets.overlayCopy: A better way to belong.
